prompts.name: Personalization Text ở tay áo Sweatshirt
prompts.note: Dùng kèm file design PNG nền trong suốt, đính kèm thủ công vào Flow
prompts.body:
Create a photorealistic flat-lay mockup of **one folded crewneck sweatshirt** _(or: two folded crewneck sweatshirts placed side by side)_, personalized with real thread embroidery, in a cozy Etsy-style product photo.

**Faithfully reproduce the attached design:**  
— Treat the attached image as the EXACT embroidery pattern. Reproduce every letter, word, number and spelling EXACTLY as attached — do not alter, re-spell, add, or drop text. Keep the same fonts/lettering style, icons, shapes, layout, spacing and proportions, and the exact same thread colors.  
— Convert only the surface into realistic raised thread embroidery (satin/fill stitches, visible thread texture) following the fabric's folds and lighting. Preserve the original aspect ratio — do not stretch or distort.

**Sleeve text (very important):**  
— On the folded **sleeve cuff**, add a small **cursive/script embroidered name(s)**, stacked vertically if more than one name.  
— Use the name(s) from this list — pick one set per sweatshirt: **{Jacob / Mike, Lucy, John / Emma / Noah, Ava / Liam}**. Spell them EXACTLY as written.

**Sweatshirt color(s):** pick one per shirt from {heather charcoal|Than tiêu / forest green|Xanh rêu / navy|Xanh than / white|Trắng / sand|Cát / beige|Be / maroon|Đỏ mận / sport grey|Xám sport}.

**Scene & props (flat-lay on soft neutral linen):** a woven round placemat under the sweatshirt, plus a few cozy props: {tortoiseshell glasses, small potted succulent, lit candle, a couple of blurred polaroid family photos, ceramic dish}. Arrange them tastefully around the sweatshirt(s).

Style: warm natural window light, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, photorealistic cozy lifestyle product photography, Etsy-style. The embroidered design stays the clear focal point and remains faithful to the attached artwork.

prompts.name: Số hóa artwork thành thêu máy (5 màu)
prompts.note: Dùng kèm artwork 2D đính kèm — chuyển thành design thêu máy tối đa 5 màu chỉ rồi mockup lên áo
prompts.body:
Convert the attached 2D flat artwork into a PRODUCTION-READY MACHINE EMBROIDERY design, then present it stitched onto a garment mockup.

STEP 1 — DIGITIZE INTO COLOR BLOCKS:
- Reduce the entire artwork to a MAXIMUM OF 5 SOLID THREAD COLORS. No gradients, no blends, no halftones, no anti-aliased soft edges — every area becomes one flat block of a single thread color with a hard boundary.
- Merge small tonal variations into the nearest block. Simplify fussy micro-detail that is smaller than 1.5mm and would be unstitchable.
- Thicken every thin line to a minimum 1.5mm satin-stitch column so it can be physically stitched; delete hairlines that are too fine.
- Every shape must be CLOSED and self-contained, sitting edge-to-edge with its neighbor block (butt-registered), never overlapping into mush.
- Total design size approximately 20cm wide — proportions and silhouette of the original artwork must remain recognizable and unchanged.

STEP 2 — ASSIGN STITCH TYPES PER BLOCK:
- Large interior areas = tatami / fill stitch, with the STITCH ANGLE ROTATED DIFFERENTLY for each adjacent block so light catches each panel differently and the block structure is clearly readable.
- Outlines, borders and all lettering = raised satin-stitch columns, 3-4mm wide, tightly packed diagonal thread passes, domed and glossy.
- Small accents, eyes and dots = dense satin blocks sitting slightly higher than the fill beneath them.
- Fine interior details = single-pass running stitch, broken and slightly wobbly, with individual needle penetration points visible.

STEP 3 — PHYSICAL REALISM:
- Embroidery sits 1.5-2mm proud of the fabric and casts a soft contact shadow.
- Visible seam line where two thread colors butt against each other.
- Ragged fringe of individual thread tips along the outer silhouette; fabric nap fibers slightly overlapping the edges.
- Strong directional specular sheen on polyester thread — some stitch rows bright, adjacent rows darker purely from thread direction.
- Slight fabric puckering and needle holes around the stitched block.

STEP 4 — MOCKUP PRESENTATION:
- Place the finished embroidery centered on the chest of a folded garment.
- Top-down flat lay on warm oak wood, soft natural window light from upper left, cozy seasonal props (ceramic mug, candle, dried leaves) softly out of focus.
- Photorealistic product photograph, shallow depth of field, warm neutral grade, sharp macro texture on the embroidery.

prompts.name: Sweatshirt gấp gọn xếp chồng
prompts.note: Dùng kèm file design PNG nền trong suốt, đính kèm thủ công vào Flow
prompts.body:
Create a photorealistic lifestyle mockup of a **stack of neatly folded crewneck sweatshirts** (3–4 sweatshirts stacked on top of each other), with the attached design shown as **real thread embroidery** along the **folded front edge** of each sweatshirt (the way embroidered text appears on a folded sweatshirt in Etsy product photos).

**Reproduce the attached design faithfully:**  
— Treat the attached image as the EXACT embroidery pattern. Reproduce every letter, word, number and spelling EXACTLY as in the attached image — do not alter, re-spell, add, or drop any text. Keep the same fonts/lettering style, the same floral/wildflower letter styling, the same icons, shapes, layout, spacing and proportions.  
— Keep the exact same thread colors as in the attached design.  
— Convert only the surface/material into realistic raised thread embroidery (satin/fill stitches, visible thread texture, tiny 3D floral stitches) that follows the fabric's folds and lighting.  
— Preserve the original aspect ratio — do not stretch, squash, or distort the design.

**Layout:**  
— Fold each sweatshirt so the embroidered design sits centered and fully readable along the front folded edge.  
— Stack the sweatshirts in a tidy pile, slightly offset so each embroidered design is visible.  
— Give each sweatshirt in the stack a **different color**, picking from: {sport grey|Xám sport / dusty pink|Hồng bụi / sand|Cát / beige|Be / forest green|Xanh rêu / military green|Xanh quân đội / sage|Xanh sage / navy|Xanh than / light blue|Xanh nhạt / rust|Nâu gỉ / maroon|Đỏ mận / mustard|Vàng mù tạt / teal|Xanh cổ vịt / lilac|Tím lilac / cream|Kem}.

**Randomize the background/scene (pick ONE per image so each result looks different):**  
{rustic wooden table with wooden thread spools, embroidery scissors, needles and a few lavender sprigs|Bàn gỗ mộc — suốt chỉ, kéo thêu, oải hương / cozy craft room with shelves of colorful fabric bolts and thread, soft window light|Phòng thủ công — kệ vải, chỉ màu / sunny garden with a metal arch, roses, daisies and a terracotta plant pot|Vườn nắng — vòm hoa hồng, cúc / bright wooden table by a window with a potted plant and embroidery floss cards|Bàn gỗ bên cửa sổ — cây cảnh, chỉ thêu / linen surface with dried flowers and vintage sewing tools|Nền linen — hoa khô, đồ khâu vintage}

Style: warm natural window light, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, cozy handmade/artisan feel, photorealistic Etsy-style product photography. The embroidered designs stay sharp and are the clear focal point, faithful to the attached artwork.

prompts.name: Thiết kế trên ngực trái Sweatshirt
prompts.note: Dùng kèm file design PNG nền trong suốt, đính kèm thủ công vào Flow
prompts.body:
Create a photorealistic mockup of a cozy folded crewneck sweatshirt with the attached design shown as real thread embroidery on the **LEFT CHEST**.

**Placement & scale (very important):**  
— Place the design on the **wearer's left chest**, in the standard small "left-chest logo" position (the pocket area), same as a real embroidered brand logo.  
— Keep the design **SMALL** — roughly the size of a palm, about 8–12 cm wide, occupying only a small area of the chest. Do NOT enlarge it to fill or center it across the whole chest.  
— Preserve the **original aspect ratio and internal proportions** of the artwork exactly — do not stretch, squash, crop, or distort it. Scale it down as a whole.

Treat the attached image as the EXACT embroidery pattern to reproduce stitch-for-stitch. Convert only the SURFACE/MATERIAL into realistic stitched thread (raised satin/fill stitches, visible thread texture) — but do NOT change what the design shows:  
— Reproduce every letter, word, number and spelling EXACTLY as in the attached image. Do not alter, re-spell, add, or drop any text. Keep the same fonts/lettering style.  
— Keep the exact same icons, shapes, layout, arrangement, spacing and proportions.  
— Keep the exact same thread colors as the colors in the attached design.  
— The embroidery must be a faithful 1:1 copy of the attached artwork, only now made of thread and following the fabric's folds and lighting.

Randomize everything AROUND the design so each result looks different (pick one of each):  
— Sweatshirt color: {red|Đỏ / orange|Cam / sand|Cát / beige|Be / white|Trắng / sport grey|Xám sport / black|Đen / grey|Xám / light pink|Hồng nhạt / light blue|Xanh nhạt / chocolate|Sô-cô-la / brown|Nâu / maroon|Đỏ mận / carolina blue|Xanh carolina / forest green|Xanh rêu / military green|Xanh quân đội / navy|Xanh than}  
— Camera distance: {close-up showing thread texture|Cận cảnh thấy sợi chỉ / medium folded flat-lay|Trung cảnh gấp flat-lay / wider styled scene with props|Toàn cảnh có đạo cụ}  
— Surface & scene: {rustic wood table|Bàn gỗ mộc / linen cloth|Vải linen / lace doily|Khăn ren}  
— Props (a few, cozy seasonal): {vintage books, brass compass, pinecones, small pumpkins, lit candle, ceramic mug, felt hat, dried flowers, acorns}

Style: warm natural window light, soft shadows, shallow depth of field, photorealistic cozy lifestyle product photography, Etsy-style. The embroidered design stays the clear focal point (even though small) and remains faithful to the attached artwork.
